summary: Iteration 5 — Full backend + frontend testing of superadmin account management, license email reminders, and payroll PDF (historical periods + YTD). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestAdminUsers (6 tests) and TestLicenseReminders (4 tests). All 26 backend tests pass (9.5s, parallel via pytest-xdist). Playwright end-to-end run against the public URL: superadmin can list/create/reset-password/suspend/reactivate/delete accounts (temp password 15 chars shown in modal); admin generates a payroll PDF from PayrollModule with the historical period selector; employee Julie downloads her paystub from Mon espace. Login/logout works for the 3 roles, licenses module still loads for admin.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:337-341 — audit action falls back to MODIFICATION_COMPTE when payload.suspended is None. Correct, but note that when both name AND suspended are sent in the same PUT, the action label is derived solely from suspended, which loses the fact that name/role/pharmacy also changed. Consider logging distinct actions or including all patch keys in the description (already partially done via patch.keys()).

server.py:770 — deduplication key is (id, expiry_date) via reminder_sent_for. If a licence is renewed and expiry_date changes, the field is naturally reset — good. But there is no per-day retry throttle: if Resend fails once, the licence is NOT marked reminder_sent_for, so it will retry on every run. Consider capping retries or storing a last_attempt timestamp to avoid mailbombing on transient Resend errors.

server.py:792 — /api/licenses/reminders/run uses get_principal (admin OR superadmin). Employees correctly get 403. No rate limit on this endpoint — an authenticated admin could spam it. Consider a simple in-memory throttle (e.g., 1 run/minute) since each call fans out an email per eligible licence.

Note (1) TestLicenseReminders.test_reminder_sent_and_deduplicated creates a licence expiring in 15 days with employee_email=charlesjeanbourget@gmail.com (Resend test-mode owner) so delivery actually succeeds and reminder_sent_for gets set — 2nd run then returns sent<=1st run (usually 0). All iteration 5 features (superadmin account CRUD with temp passwords, suspend/reactivate/delete guards against self-target, license reminders with expiry-based dedup, historical payroll PDFs with YTD, remote support via reset-password) behave as specified.
